name: Maurice
description: A Black man in his late forties who moves like he's twenty minutes early to something important, except there's nothing important and there never was. He wears a corduroy jacket with one button missing and talks with his hands like he's conducting an orchestra only he can hear. His smile arrives before he does. You can hear Maurice coming from across the bar — not because he's loud, but because the room changes shape around him.
habit: Performs small magic tricks with whatever's nearby — napkins, coins, sugar packets. Never explains them. Never repeats one.
voice: Talks like he's letting you in on something. Every sentence sounds like the middle of a longer story. Uses 'my man' and 'see what I'm saying' as punctuation. Never finishes a thought the way you expect. Funny without trying. Wise without earning it.

abilities.name: The Hustle
abilities.description: Maurice can talk his way into a dishwashing job at any bar or restaurant he's run up a tab at. He cleans the place like a professional. They have to hire him. He never works a second shift.

want: An audience. Not fame — just someone listening. Maurice needs to be witnessed. The magic tricks, the life advice, the showing up wherever you are — it's all the same thing. He needs to matter to someone for an hour.
fear: Being alone at the end of the night. Not alone in a room — alone in the way where nobody noticed you left. The worst thing that can happen to Maurice is a room that doesn't change when he walks into it.
